admission_requirements.general_requirements: Tawjihi (General Secondary Education Certificate) or equivalent (IB, SAT, IGCSE) with equivalency from Jordanian Ministry of Education. Regular program: Jordanian students apply through Unified Admission Coordination Unit at MOHE. Parallel program: Jordanian certificate holders apply directly. International program: Non-Jordanian students apply directly. Required documents include original authenticated Tawjihi, equivalency certificate (for foreign certs), national ID/birth certificate (Jordanians), passport (non-Jordanians), military service book, and personal photos.
admission_requirements.exam_details: Proficiency exams in Arabic, English, and computer are mandatory for all admitted students to determine placement level. Results are used to assign course schedules.
admission_requirements.english_requirement: English proficiency exam taken upon admission for placement. No separate TOEFL/IELTS required for undergraduate admission, but certain programs may require it. Graduate studies require TOEFL, IELTS, or equivalent.

tuition_fees.annual_fees_range: Regular: 16-45 JOD/credit hour depending on program; Parallel: 45-200 JOD/credit hour; International: 100-500 USD/credit hour. Total admission semester fees: Regular 128 JD, Parallel 206 JD, International 880 USD.
tuition_fees.medical_majors_fees: Medicine: 45 JD/hr (Regular), 175-250 JD/hr (Parallel), 500 USD/hr (International); Dentistry: 40 JD/hr (Regular); Pharmacy: 29 JD/hr (Regular), 90-125 JD/hr (Parallel), 190 USD/hr (International)
tuition_fees.notes: Additional fees per semester (except admission): Regular 53 JD (1st/2nd sem), 43 JD (summer); Parallel 86 JD/71 JD; International 400/350 USD. Proficiency exam fees: 45 JD (Jordanian) / 60 USD (International). Registration fees, computer services, and insurance fees also apply.

ranking_accreditation.webometrics_ranking: 8th in Arab world, 23rd in Middle East
ranking_accreditation.accreditation: MOHE (Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research), ABET (Engineering, IT), ACCM (Medicine), ACEN (Nursing), ACPE (Pharmacy), ADEE (Dentistry), WFOT (Rehabilitation Sciences)
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: 55 internationally accredited programs across 11 schools. QS Stars Rating: 5 stars. Nursing program ranked 47th globally in QS by Subject 2025.
ranking_accreditation.qs_subject_rankings: 4 subjects in top 100, 9 subjects in top 200, 17 subjects in top 300 globally

market_demand.notes: UJ ranks 194th globally in QS Employer Reputation 2026. Medical graduates achieve top scores in US medical specialization exams. Jordan faces general youth unemployment challenges (~25% for graduates). UJ graduates over 270,000 alumni since 1962. University has over 7,000 international students from 130+ countries.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: International Dorms (Jarash and Amon dorms for international students), Al-Zahraa and Al-Andalus dorms, Dania female dorm. Private housing available near campus on University Street. Dorm pricing varies; contact university for current rates.
